name: Solvent screening (molecular / substance parameters)
description: Maximize reaction yield over candidate solvents that BayBE encodes from SMILES into cheminformatics descriptors (a SubstanceParameter). Requires the BayBE backend and the 'baybe[chem]' optional dependency (shipped by default in bo-engine-baybe).

parameters.name: solvent
parameters.description: Candidate solvent. The category labels are the experimental values you submit/observe; the SMILES in parameter_options.baybe.substance_data are what BayBE turns into descriptors.
